steps.author: Agent
steps.text:
# Coffee notes

Espresso needs a fine grind and about twenty five seconds of extraction time.

Pour over coffee benefits from a medium grind and a slow, steady pour of hot water.

Cold brew steeps for twelve to eighteen hours in the refrigerator before serving.

steps.author: Agent
steps.text:
# Coffee notes

Espresso needs a fine grind and roughly twenty five seconds of extraction time at nine bar.

Pour over coffee benefits from a medium grind and a slow, steady pour of hot water.

Cold brew steeps for twelve to eighteen hours in the refrigerator before serving.

A French press uses a coarse grind and about four minutes of steeping.

steps.author: Human
steps.text:
# Garden plan

Tomatoes go along the south fence where they get full sun all afternoon. The basil is planted between them to keep pests away and to save space.

Water the beds early in the morning, twice a week in dry weather.
